title: clinarmonize/clinicalharmonize concept pack schema
description: Schema for a concept pack (assets/packs/<name>.yaml). The pack IS the target variable set: everything the pipeline can ever produce a candidate mapping for is declared here, nowhere else.

vocabulary.description: Pinned vocabulary release the pack's concept_ids resolve against. This string is hashed as part of the pack's identity.

variables.description: The target variable set. At least one variable MUST be flagged outcome: true (§0 the invariant): that flag, and only that flag, is what 'the outcome variable' means anywhere in this pipeline.

name.description: Target variable name, used as the column name downstream.

domain.description: The OMOP-shaped domain the variable is drawn from, or 'derived' for a variable computed from other domains (e.g. a survival time).

concept_id.description: Standard OMOP concept id this variable denotes. 0 is the standard OMOP 'unmapped' placeholder. Required unless domain is 'derived'.

type.description: Statistical type of the variable. Required unless domain is 'derived'.

domain_values.description: Enumerated legal values, for nominal/ordinal variables.

derivation.description: Name of the derivation rule that computes this variable. Required when domain is 'derived'.

unit.description: Unit the derived/continuous variable is expressed in.

outcome.description: The invariant flag (§0). true means this variable IS the outcome, and per the invariant, no harmonization decision anywhere in the pipeline may ever be a function of it. Never inferred from a name; always this flag.
